## Research status

**Technical owners.** 2 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Personal Compute Hives and Federated Edge Intelligence](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/personal-compute-hives-and-federated-edge-intelligence.html), [Physical Compute Infrastructure, Energy, and Environmental Constraints](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/physical-compute-infrastructure-energy-and-environmental-constraints.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 7.

**What would change the conclusion.** Deployment studies showing physical constraints and topology do not materially affect accepted useful output, resilience, privacy, or total cost would narrow this layer.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
